a) Alignment refers to sequence comparison to find similarity level between query sequence and different database sequences. List 4 reasons why you may want to align sequences. 4marks
b) Global and local alignments are the main methods for sequence comparison, which are mostly defined by dynamic programming approach; identify and briefly explain one dynamic programming technique used for the methods respectively. 4marks
c) With the mathematical representation, state the steps involved in each of the dynamic programming types mentioned above. 6marks
d) Find the best alignment of these two sequences: 8marks
ACATTCA
ACATCA
Using -2 as a gap penalty, -3 as a mismatch penalty, and 2 as the score for a match.
e) Find the best local alignment between these two sequences: 8marks
ATCATCCCAC
TCTATCCT
Using -2 as a gap penalty, -3 as a mismatch penalty, and 2 as the score for a match.
